arguments.message: Hi there! A genuine Meridian invoice will always appear in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If you received an email with an invoice that doesn’t match anything shown there—or the amount or due date doesn’t line up with your plan, seats, or usage—it’s a strong sign the invoice is not legitimate. Treat it as unverified until you can confirm it in the Billing → Invoices view, and do not pay it based solely on the email. If you’re still unsure, feel free to forward the invoice to us and we’ll help verify it.
